author: fenglin
environment: Linux x86_64, Node 24.22.3, Chromium 156, CPU. The rc.5 version was checked against npm metadata and the installed host.

voice: voice interruption stops the exact native main continuation, releases phone presence, and preserves later owner input and project work
chat: Ask mode does not initiate an idle chat or native open opportunity
IM submits authenticated owner input to the same native main session and pages exact, deduplicated replies
Full access allows the model to independently send a new message or quietly finish the next open turn
A project can independently publish one attributed IM message without making its private native answer an IM message
Pause prevents delivery and restart preserves cursor and never requeues the same owner submission

deliveryPath.name: 小肥鱼 · 中文动画少女声

preview.source: Two independently submitted public replies using the same synthesis path as the new default phone voice, joined by 0.38 seconds of silence. No pitch or playback-rate post-processing.

interruption.recognized: 先等一下，我想说另一件事。

browserPhone.microphone: Real Chromium media stack and neural ASR, using a known Mandarin WAV as its microphone input; real synthesized PCM was played.
browserPhone.dialogue: Controlled local Harness model supplied the approved conversation text.

repeat.chatModel: Same deterministic protocol dialogue, real neural TTS/ASR.

packagedWebPreflight: fresh official Web template installs the exact local tarball into its own profile
official browser shows a single floating fish, with the single active Spirit preset
three bundled transparent atlases are byte-exact over HTTP and support HEAD and revalidation
voice metadata, audio reference, script and preview survive real tarball installation and HTTP
real Chromium decodes and plays the shipped character demo without starting speech synthesis
browser chat sends one owner message and one authorized reply in the same native turn
an explicitly published project message shows its source, and clicking opens the private native source session
reload keeps the same hidden main session, deduplicated chat and ordinary project membership
scope: The character voice is an original speaker design. Neither the objective checks nor this short audition rate artistic resemblance or personal preference.
Streaming is by synthesized phrase. CPU load, hardware and the selected chat model can change the time before the first phrase.
Physical microphone capture on each machine, non-Linux platforms and commercial rights in optional third-party models are outside these runtime tests.
